race.description: Ais Certifiers Eddie Latta Memorial Country Boosted Hcp (C1)
race.comment: BOLD CONQUER (6) has made the right start to his career, placing on debut before winning a Mdn at Goulburn and beating REGOR by a length. He stays on 1200m and the light weight gives him the strongest winning profile. Can continue to work through the grades. JIMMY'S READY (8) resumes after taking on Saturday company at Eagle Farm, and while that final run before the spell was plain, his better 1200m figures make him a genuine danger if he returns switched on. Watch for him flying late in the race. REGOR (2) was decisive as a well-supported favourite in a Mdn at Albury and has reliable 1200m form, though he meets BOLD CONQUER again after being beaten by him at Goulburn. Maps for a kind run though and can turn the tables. BOUND TO FIRE (9) was second at this venue first-up at big odds and is not to be discounted. KIRWANS BRIDGE (4) has claims first-up.
